payload.title: Loading data into Pyleoclim objects
payload.summary: This notebook demonstrates how to load LiPD data into Pyleoclim objects and store them as pickle files for easier access in future analyses. The process involves reading LiPD files from a specified directory, extracting essential time series data, and converting them into Pyleoclim GeoSeries objects. The notebook uses Python libraries such as LiPD, Pyleoclim, and pickle to handle data loading and serialization. The output consists of serialized pickle files containing the processed paleoclimate data.
goals: Load LiPD data into Pyleoclim objects
Serialize data into pickle files for easy access

section_blurbs.blurb: The section focuses on loading LiPD data into Pyleoclim objects and storing them as pickle files. It involves reading data from a directory, processing time series data, and converting them into GeoSeries objects for further analysis.
section_blurbs.heading: Loading data into Pyleoclim objects

outputs: Serialized pickle files containing Pyleoclim objects
